name: Starry Make a Wish
name_jp: 極星お星さまにお願い
effects:
Grants Damage +5% to party, grants Master Mode & Instant ATB 1 to user
Master Mode: Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1; Chases SB/LB cast with single-target DeProtect 30% & DeShell 30% for 5 seconds (max 1 chase); If target has DEF/RES/MND buff, chases with AOE DEF/RES/MND -50% for 8 seconds (max 1 chase)
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Prismatic/NE magic attacks, Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Weakness Damage +30% for 1 turn to party, removes Master Mode
